in_hindi.name: दिन्द्याल
in_hindi.meaning: दिन का देव, सूर्ज का देव (God of the sun)
in_hindi.long_meaning: Shining like the sun, divine. A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Dindu' meaning sun and 'Yal' meaning god or divine.

in_marathi.name: Dindyal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Dharma
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dindyal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dindyal is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'dharma' which means righteousness, duty, or law. This name is believed to be given to those who uphold and follow the path of dharma, ensuring harmony and balance in the universe.
